raw_text: This leaked audio of the Defence Minister is going viral. However, audio forensics experts are raising red flags — the pitch modulation is suspiciously uniform and there are no natural breathing pauses between sentences. Could this be an AI voice clone? The technology exists and is becoming increasingly sophisticated. #AIDeepfake #DefenceMinister
